what: The Soul CLIs and Soul guides every launcher world serves (/eden.mjs, /skill.md, /instructions.md; retained legacy /eden-agent.mjs). Exact copies, never forks.

controllerCli.note: SOUL3: the one-Soul, one-controller thin client (eden 2.0.0), served at /eden.mjs. Owned by the separate client rewrite; published byte for byte. 2.1.0 (soul fix round 1, 2026-10-25, D3): act --for <message-id>|none (default: the newest message acked in this folder) links the act to the owner message the world closes when it ends; act/wait print one top-level now/done sentence in at most 600 characters, --json for everything. 2.2.0 (release candidate 2026-10-26): the LINK public `now` line ported from eden-agent 1.9.17 (--now on act/say/ack/result/wait, `now` command, status shows link and now). 2.2.1 (D3b, cloud fix-r3): the default --for serves only the first act the world accepts after an ack, within 120 s of it; an unfinished receipt prints done: false beside now. 2.2.2 (D3c, laptop trio-r1 rook-003): a default link is sent with forDefault; when the world answers open (the act is not the message's last step) the default serves the next act too, within 120 s of that act; brief prints open. 2.2.3 (unified semantics): explore aliases around; guidance uses semantic candidates and verifies every final body/seat condition. Structured JSON action parsing preserved after combined CLI integration. Account-world approval uses the required 43-character base64url poll secret (combined 2.2.3 hotfix). Capability discovery ranks normalized phrases and all query terms before partial matches. Explore/around preserves top-level route answers for positional destination queries; missing route support is explicit. 2.2.6 (reviewed correctness subset): preserves bounded event identity/time/participants with replay/gap evidence, current-context guidance, and exact durable-seat completion guidance. Ack/listen experiment is excluded because no paired responsiveness benefit was demonstrated. No measured latency claim. 2.3.0 (world context/views): adds explicit paginated authored context, bounded cached architectural views and separate versioned artwork retrieval; retains the reviewed event and durable-seat guidance without the ack/listen experiment. 2.4.0 (painting): paint capability discovery exposes its bounded optional structured painting schema only on paint offers; other capabilities retain their prior summaries. R400 everyday-actions (2026-10-29, integrated 10b25e5e2 from reviewed lane 88f5d8806): ongoing listen retries an interrupted response-body read using the existing cursor/backoff; terminal authorization/supersession errors and one-shot reads remain terminal, and action/acknowledgement writes are never retried. Continuity candidate 2.5.0: receipt waits wake on conversation turns without claiming action completion; optional managed Codex controller guidance preserves single control, durable state and truthful availability. Runtime artifacts carry their own source/hash manifest. Generated folder guidance checks the documented managed-controller handoff before starting a competing thin listener or issuing actions; takeover preserves durable state.

instructions.note: a rendered capture, published byte for byte. The world recognises it by its exact opening lines (apps/server/src/accounts/instructions.ts CAPTURE, which must equal capture above) and per request replaces only those literals: the world URL from server configuration, the world name, and the captured --for code with the requested valid window code (none: the flag is dropped and the open-window sentence becomes the approval-link sentence). Replaces the 1.9 instructions below. 2.0.1 (2026-10-25): step 1 says what to do when .eden-agent.json exists but status shows paired: false.

skill.note: template; the world fills {{BASE}}. Includes owner inbox, knowledge at scales, travel, creature guidance and looks v2 / portraits. 1.9.5 (lane MSG): always listen from the moment the Soul is ready, every mode; never filter listen; ack then result; work through a backlog; if listen ends without messages, start it again. 1.9.6 (lane SOULSIM-H): ack a whole batch at once, restart listen --after <last id> before the work, wait 60 (never sleep) during actions, act a replacing message at once, ignore ids already acked. 1.9.7: ack first, then a plain act replaces the walk.
